mentions.name: ECI — trustworthy technology essay
mentions.description: A written essay laying out thoughts on open, freedom-respecting and privacy-respecting technology, highlighting newly available trustworthy mobile hardware such as the Starlite tablet, Furilabs and Fairphone, with the aim of starting discussion and bringing these efforts together.
mentions.problem: Open, freedom- and privacy-respecting technology products (Starlite tablet, Furilabs, Fairphone) have only recently become available after fifteen-plus years of waiting, and the new mobile hardware gets little attention or discussion.
